result.summary: The page is largely well-designed and functional. The main visual issue is horizontal content clipping in the 'Fastest near you' carousel, where the third restaurant card ('Trattoria Piccol...') is cut off at the right edge without a clear visual affordance indicating more content is scrollable. Other observations are minor cosmetic notes.

issues.description: In the 'Fastest near you' horizontal carousel, the third card ('Trattoria Piccol') is abruptly clipped at the right screen edge. The card title is truncated mid-word and there is no gradient fade, peek spacing, or scroll indicator to signal that the row is horizontally scrollable.
issues.suggestion: Add a subtle right-edge fade/gradient or ensure a partial 'peek' of the next card with consistent padding so users understand the row scrolls horizontally. Also apply text ellipsis with proper max-width to the restaurant name.

issues.description: The notification bell icon in the top-right has a red dot indicator but no visible label or badge count, and the icon button's tap target may be small relative to recommended 44x44pt minimum.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the bell button meets minimum tap-target size and provide an accessibility label (e.g., 'Notifications, 1 unread').

issues.description: The 'Popular right now' card images use dark photographic backgrounds while the 'Fastest near you' cards use lighter illustration-style backgrounds, creating a slightly inconsistent visual treatment between the two carousels.
issues.suggestion: Unify image treatment (consistent overlay/opacity or consistent illustration style) across both sections for a more cohesive look.
